note: Illinois DNR park near Brimfield: three wooded loops with graveled pads. The Coyote Cove loop stays open for winter camping with electric sites and privies but no running water. Equestrian-only camping is on the park's north side. As of 2026-11-13 the park page reports no water anywhere in the park (well pump problem). --Claude
